variant_decisions.evidence: The only variation is Hebrew verb number: plural qere יִהְיוּ against singular ketiv יהיה. The subject is plural either way ("they ... two nations"), and English requires a plural verb with a plural subject regardless of Hebrew agreement, so "they shall be no more two nations" is the natural rendering of both. No italicized supply and no mapped textual_variant note distinguishes them; the qere base fallback carries the projection.
